_comment: Verdicts confirmed by hand, for links the checker cannot see for itself.
Some shops hard-block automated browsers, so tools/check_links.py can only
ever record `maybe` for them. A person opening the page in a normal browser
can settle it in seconds. Those calls go here.
This file always wins over data/link_status.json, and tools/unify.py marks
the source `verified: manual` so a hand-made call is never mistaken for a
measured one. Keep `by` and `at` filled in - the point is that the
